objective: Make the risk-constrained KV budget planner evidence strong enough for an ICML submission direction.

runtime_features.runtime_methods_filter: Use --runtime_methods to run only full_kv_cache plus the target planner, reducing irrelevant baselines and long-context OOM risk.
runtime_features.variable_budget_conformal_auto: Use --variable_budget_tail_threshold -1 to read selected_tau from conformal_tailrisk_planner.pt.

primary_experiments.name: longbench_m4_conformal_auto

acceptance_criteria: LongBench m4 variable/conformal planner should match full score. If it remains below full, it is not suitable as the default paper method.
At least one input-side planner should substantially improve LongBench online speed over output verifier floor2/floor3.
Mixed13 should keep full-level score around 69.23 percent and online speed near or above 1.0x.
RULER 8k should keep full-level score and online speed above 1.0x.
RULER 4k/8k m3 and 16k m2 shards should reduce sample-count criticism for the scaling claim.
Input-side planner scaling should replace output-verifier scaling when verifier overhead dominates 8k m3 runtime.
